name: LLM Bug Benchmark
description: Matched-pair benchmark for LLM code review on 690 real bug fixes from 11 Python projects. Finding: injected bugs are 48 points easier to detect than the real bugs in the same functions (paired, 95% CI [+33, +62]) — mutation testing is a floor for LLM bug-detection benchmarks, not an estimate.
